visual_brief.narrative_function: Canonical identity reference for all later hero assets.
visual_brief.first_read: Face, silhouette, and signature identity marks.

composition.lens_behavior: neutral low-distortion reference perspective; no wide-angle exaggeration
composition.focus_depth: entire character equally readable; no shallow-focus loss of costume detail

lighting.color_relationship: neutral; do not tint identity colors

materials: Describe signature fabrics, hair, skin/fur, metal, or other identity-critical surfaces.
environment_rules: No scenery; this is an identity reference.
continuity: This anchor becomes canonical for downstream tasks.
avoid: generic beauty retouching that changes identity
dramatic lighting that obscures canonical colors
visual_brief.emotional_intent: Trustworthy, neutral production reference rather than a dramatic beauty shot.

identity: Replace with exact CharacterBible identity invariants
style: Match VisualAuthority visual language without drift
narrative: No narrative facts invented or contradicted
lighting_color: Identity-critical colors and materials remain legible
structure: Full subject visible on transparent background
usability: Readable silhouette at thumbnail size; production reference quality
material: Hair, skin, cloth, and brass read as distinct materials without changing the project abstraction level
